title: A Decomposition-Based Data-Driven Branch-and-Bound Approach for Black-Box Global Optimization
summary: Many scientific and engineering applications require the global optimization of expensive black-box functions. In high-dimensional settings, however, achieving computational scalability is a major challenge. To address this challenge, we propose a distributed spatial branch-and-bound framework that exploits partially separable structure for the global optimization of box-constrained black-box problems.
